domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 轨道板或底座按分段独立单元布置的纵向连接类型。
usage_note: 原文把轨道板UT用于CRTS I和III，与LCT分开；该分类不能无条件推广到所有构件。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: For the track slab, the longitudinal connection of adjacent slabs has two types: unit type (UT) for CRTS I and CRTS III and longitudinal connected type (LCT) for CRTS II, as shown in Fig. 3.
Uts represents the relative shape function of track and soil elements, and correspondingly, Ut and Us are the shape functions of track and soil elements.
